restaurant-mott32-las-vegas.name: Mott 32 Las Vegas
restaurant-mott32-las-vegas.notes: Default restaurant workspace for Menu Matrix training.

peking-duck.name: Apple Wood Roasted 42 Days Peking Duck
peking-duck.description: Signature Mott 32 cut, carved for crisp skin and tender meat
peking-duck.details: One of Mott 32's signature dishes. Teach the team to mention the apple wood roast, 42-day duck, crisp skin, and classic tableside-style presentation.

soup-dumplings.name: Traditional Iberico Pork Shanghainese Soup Dumplings
soup-dumplings.description: Four delicate xiao long bao with savory pork broth
soup-dumplings.details: A dim sum staple. Coach staff to warn guests the dumplings contain hot broth and should be eaten carefully with the soup spoon.

bbq-pork-bun.name: Crispy Sugar Coated BBQ Iberico Pork Bun
bbq-pork-bun.description: Three baked buns with sweet-savory barbecue pork filling
bbq-pork-bun.details: This is a baked dim sum item with a crisp sugar-coated exterior and rich Iberico pork barbecue center. Good for guests who like sweet and savory.

smoked-black-cod.name: Signature Smoked Black Cod
smoked-black-cod.description: Smoky, silky black cod with a rich Cantonese-style glaze
smoked-black-cod.details: A polished seafood signature. Describe it as delicate, smoky, slightly sweet, and very soft in texture.

lobster-fried-rice.name: Signature Maine Lobster Fried Rice
lobster-fried-rice.description: King oyster mushrooms and edamame folded into lobster fried rice
lobster-fried-rice.details: A premium rice and noodle section dish. Highlight the lobster, mushroom, and edamame; confirm shellfish allergy before recommending.
